Hi Sofia,

Thanks for working with us on the MSA and Order Form. We finished internal review and attached the redlined MSA (MSA_v3_redline.pdf) and a clean copy of the updated Order Form (OrderForm_Acme_v2.pdf). We're ready to proceed to signature, but need to confirm the execution plan so our procurement and legal teams are aligned. Quick items from our side: 

- Signers: CFO (primary) and VP Procurement (witness if required). We'll confirm exact signer names by EOD tomorrow.
- We prefer sequential signing: Acme signs first, then Redwood.
- We require an executed clean PDF + DocuSign audit trail.
- There may be a requirement for the CFO to sign with an attached POA for delegated authority (we'll attach if needed).

Can you provide a short runbook or checklist for how Redwood will prepare the envelope, required fields, and clean-copy delivery? Also please confirm whether Redwood needs notarization or in-person witnessing in any jurisdiction for this account.

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + OF redlines — planning execution window

Emma — thanks for the redlines and the clean OF. We can run this on DocuSign with the following proposed runbook; keeping it intentionally tight to meet your quarter close.

Proposed execution runbook (high level):
1) Finalize clean copy: Karthik will produce the final "clean" MSA that incorporates non-substantive redline edits (he may send back a question if any redline is substantive).
2) Bundle package: clean MSA (PDF), Order Form, and a single cover letter (PDF) into one envelope.
3) Signature order: Acme signs first (CFO), then Redwood (authorized exec). Sequential signing with required initial fields and signature blocks.
4) Signer verification: Request name, title, and a short attestation. If Acme provides a POA / signer-delegation, we will attach it to the envelope pre-sign.
5) Authentication: Default is email verification. If Acme requests access-code verification or phone OTP for the CFO, we can add it — note that adds a small friction.
6) Witnessing/notary: Redwood legal has confirmed no notarization required for this arrangement. If Acme's internal policy insists, we can accommodate but will need the notarized PDF uploaded post-sign (not via DocuSign).
7) Post-sign deliverables: executed clean PDF (flattened), DocuSign certificate-of-completion (audit trail), and a redacted copy for your internal audit if requested.
8) Delivery & storage: We'll upload executed artifacts to the shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign link. We will also publish the envelope id and audit link to the HubSpot deal.

Next steps / asks from Acme:
- Confirm exact signer full name + title for the CFO (we will map fields).
- Confirm whether you will send a POA before envelope creation.
- Any special signature ordering beyond the two signers? (e.g., witness, procurement countersign).

Ben / Karthik — looping you both for operational/legal details below. I'll hold on creating the envelope until we get the signer name and any POA. Proposed timing: create envelope tomorrow afternoon, send for signature Tue morning (05/04).

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
